turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: Here’s how to get the best result from your Faherty piece: **General Use & Care Tips** - Always check the care label inside your garment for specific instructions. - Wash in cold water on a delicate or hand wash cycle with like colors. - Turn items inside out before washing to protect fabric and details. - Air dry whenever possible—avoid high-heat dryers to extend the life of your item. - For indigo or garment-dyed pieces, wash separately the first few times to prevent color transfer. - Do not… Navigate to the message to read the full response.DisclosureBy using this chat, you are accepting and consenting to the practices described in our privacy policy.Agent saidHi! I’m Sunny, Faherty’s AI shopping assistant. I can help you find pieces, compare fits, or answer questions about an order. What can I help with?You saidHi, I have a specific need and I'm worried about picking the wrong thing. Can you help?Agent saidAbsolutely, I’m here to help!To get started, could you please share:What type of item are you looking for? (e.g., shirt, dress, pants)Any preferences for color, fabric, fit, or occasion?Are you shopping for yourself or someone else? If so, what gender?Once I have a bit more info, I’ll show you some options that match your needs!You saidI've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.Agent saidThanks for sharing your concern about quality! Faherty is known for sustainable, high-quality clothing, so I’ll make sure to show you our best options.To help you find the right item, could you let me know:What type of product are you looking for? (e.g., shirt, pants, dress)Any specific preferences for color, fabric, or fit?Are you shopping for men, women, or both?Once I have these details, I’ll show you some recommendations!You saidWhich of your products is best for that, and why is it a good fit?
